_comment: SeaweedFS S3 identity config (ADR-034). Mounted into the dev/self-hosted
seaweedfs container via `-s3.config`. This file is the SINGLE source of
truth for who can read/write the S3 gateway and which bucket is public-read.
Per ADR-023 (one bucket per visibility class): the `branding` bucket is
donor-public, every other bucket (receipts, campaigns, bulk-imports,
reports, and the future bank-statements) is private. Public-read is granted
by the `anonymous` identity scoped to `Read:branding` — NOT by a runtime
ACL call (there is no `mc anonymous set` on SeaweedFS). Anonymous reads on
any other bucket are denied because no anonymous identity covers them — an
